verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no spec at any of the common candidate paths: openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json and .well-known/openapi.json all returned 404. No documentation mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. llms.txt, markdown docs and the MCP server are present, but none of them is a machine-readable API specification. Confidence is medium because the probe covered only a limited set of paths.
